<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Chimera](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=489)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 132

The chimera heads presented below can replace one or more of the heads in the chimera stat block presented in _Monster Core_. To do so, use the Strike entry listed in the replacement head instead of the one in the original stat block; if you replace the dragon head, you must remove the creature's Dragon Breath ability. However, each of the new heads below grants new abilities.

<title level="2" right="">Chimera Heads</title> 

<title level="3" right="">Ankhrav Head</title> **Ranged** <actions string="Single Action" /> acid spit +20 ([range increment 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 2d10+9 acid

 **Spray Acid** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524)) The chimera spews acid in a 30-foot cone, dealing 9d6 acid damage to all creatures in the area (DC 26 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The chimera can't use Spray Acid again for 1d4 rounds. 

<title level="3" right="">Hippogriff Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> hippogriff beak +22 ([fatal d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=597)), **Damage** 2d6+9 piercing

 **[Rend](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=73)** <actions string="Single Action" /> hippogriff beak 

<title level="3" right="">Rotting Animal Head</title> **Ranged** <actions string="Single Action" /> virulent spit +18 ([poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669)), **Damage** 3d8+4 poison plus chimeric rot

 Chimeric Rot ([disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578)) When the chimera hits a creature with virulent spit they must succeed a DC 26 Fortitude saving throw or become [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91). 

<title level="3" right="">Snake Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> snake fangs +20 ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 2d8+7 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

 **[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** <actions string="Single Action" /> 2d8 bludgeoning, DC 24 

<title level="3" right="">Snapping Turtle Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> snapping jaws +20, **Damage** 2d10+9 piercing 

**Deep Breath** The chimera can [hold its breath](/Rules.aspx?ID=2436) for 1 hour. 

<title level="3" right="">Wolf Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> wolf jaws +20, **Damage** 2d8+9 piercing plus [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=46)

 **Leader of the Pack** The chimera's wolf jaws attacks deal 1d6 extra damage to [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) creatures. 

<title level="2" right="">Greater Chimera Heads</title> A greater chimera can have any combination of three heads chosen from the options below, each granting additional abilities inherent in the original creature. 

<title level="3" right="">Adult Dragon Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> dragon jaws +27, **Damage** 4d6+8 piercing plus 4d6 energy damage (see Draconic Bite)

 **Draconic Bite** A greater chimera's dragon head deals and extra 4d6 damage of a type matching the damage dealt by its Dragon Breath.

 **Dragon Breath** <actions string="Two Actions" /> The greater chimera deals 12d6 damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone (DC 33 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex). This breath deals either acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, mental, sonic, or spirit, depending on the kind of dragon head the greater chimera possesses. The greater chimera can't use Dragon Breath again for 1d4 rounds. 

<title level="3" right="">Cave Worm Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> worm jaws +27 ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d10+8 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

 **[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** <actions string="Single Action" /> (attack) Large, 3d10+8 bludgeoning, Rupture 24; the target must be [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) by the greater chimera's worm jaws 

<title level="3" right="">Emperor Cobra Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> emperor cobra fangs +27, **Damage** 3d8+12 piercing plus chimeric venom

 **Chimeric Venom** ([poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669)) When the greater chimera critically hits a creature with emperor cobra fangs, it deals an additional 6d6 [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). 

<title level="3" right="">Phantasmal Beast Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> phantom slam +27 ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=602), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)), **Damage** 3d8+8 void

 **Incorporeal Features** The greater chimera gains resistance 5 to all damage (except [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=610), [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737), and damage from Strikes with the [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) property rune). 

<title level="3" right="">Screeching Roc Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> beak +26 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=570)), **Damage** 3d10+8 piercing

 **Ear-splitting Screech** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) The screeching roc head emits a harsh cry that deals 9d6 sonic damage (DC 26 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save) in a 30-foot emanation. It can't use Ear-splitting Screech again for 1d4 rounds.

 **Powerful Wings** The greater chimera's fly Speed increases by 10 feet. 

<title level="3" right="">Witchwarg Head</title> **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> witchwarg jaws +25, **Damage** 2d12+8 piercing plus 1d12 cold and [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=46)

 **Freezing Breath** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676)) The greater chimera breathes a cloud of frost in a 15-foot cone that deals 9d10 cold damage (DC 33 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The greater chimera can't use Freezing Breath again for 1d4 rounds. 

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Chimera](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2879) (Creature 8), [Greater Chimera](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3257) (Creature 13)
